## Verdict
REVISE — Boundary intent is sound, but injection, forwarding supervision, and completion evidence need explicit contracts.
## Critical gaps
Specify test-only injection through app_command/audio_commands while leaving launch/services intact; launch currently discards output and returns normally on deadline, so neither return nor probe success proves app exit zero before cleanup.
## Important improvements
Require GTK-thread execution, exact pinned WrapperWidget header/library/layout plus g_type_query, checked NewLocalRef promotion and release; forbid old compositor injection. Count only bytes successfully forwarded, handle partial writes, and propagate pacat failure with explicit descriptor ownership and child reaping.
## Validation gaps
Test ABI mismatch, expired weak refs/JNI exceptions, broken pipes, blocked writes, early child exits and deadline expiry; verify mute from stream creation, expected-name-only MPRIS operations, Secret Service/microphone isolation, and no hostname/unrelated-media evidence leakage.
## Recommended revision
Define scoped hooks and independent pre-cleanup exit evidence; implement fail-closed controller and supervised muted counter; run failure guards, then the bounded real-launch attempt; verify targeted stream/bridge teardown without global enumeration.
## Acceptance Contract — Acceptance level: attested
